MANGO ATHLETE / MANGO VISION

Built around
their journey.

Mango Athlete is being designed to bring an athlete's games, availability, performance, and history together. Mango Vision is the companion sports-camera concept.

In development
Camera imagery is a design concept. Automated capture and AI analysis are planned capabilities, not verified hardware specifications.

A look at the experience
Profiles, statistics, and game imagery are illustrative. You can preview a local video; it stays on your device.

Made to explore
Move across the lights, tap a chapter, use the arrow keys, or swipe. You can preview your own local video in Capture; it stays on your device.
